preview.asking: Allow your camera and microphone so others can see and hear you.
preview.blocked: Your browser blocked the camera and microphone. Allow them in the site settings, then try again.
preview.none: No camera or microphone found. You can still join to listen and chat.

join.notesHint: Leo writes notes for the meeting’s owner. Everyone in the meeting sees this.
join.nameHint: Others in the meeting see this name.

controls.label: Meeting controls
controls.unread: {count, plural, one {# unread message} other {# unread messages}}

recording.started: Recording started. Everyone in the meeting sees that it’s recorded.
recording.stopped: Recording stopped. It will appear in File Manager in a few minutes.
recording.storageFull: Your storage is full. Free up space to record.
recording.busy: Too many meetings are being recorded right now. Try again in a few minutes.
recording.noCall: The meeting hasn’t started yet. Try again in a moment.

reactions.limited: Too many reactions. Wait a few seconds.

chat.label: Messages
chat.sendFailed: Couldn’t send the message. Try again.
chat.keptWithNotes: Messages are kept with the meeting’s notes.
chat.goneAtEnd: Messages disappear when the meeting ends.

people.hands: {count, plural, one {# raised hand} other {# raised hands}}

leave.confirmDescription: Everyone leaves and the link stops working.

not_found.title: Meeting not found
not_found.description: Check the link with the person who sent it.

removed.title: You can’t join this meeting

rate_limited.title: Too many attempts
